verdict.rationale: Recruitee's support docs say recruiters can create and manage application forms (docs-34). The API confirms jobs carry their own questions that candidates can answer (docs-36), and that default required fields (name, phone, email, CV) apply (docs-27). That evidences custom questions only thinly, and nothing covers the other two parts of the story. Missing for 10: documentation of the form-builder and question types, knockout/disqualification rules, EEOC/demographic data collection and its compliant handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
